clips.title: The story
paras: In the Stormwind Stockade, Hamhock remains locked among the rioting prisoners. The massive two-headed ogre is one of the prison’s most brutal inmates.

Hamhock is a towering two-headed ogre in the Stormwind Stockade. The prison was built for petty thieves, murderers, and political dissidents, so his size makes him an imposing presence among the cells. When the prisoners rose up and took control, Hamhock stayed amid the disorder, crushing anyone who entered his cellblock.
No record tells how Hamhock was captured or why he was locked among Stormwind’s thieves and dissidents. Whatever brought him to the Stockade, he is now one of its most dangerous inmates.
